question: What beings arrive in thousands as a result of this practice?
premises: The verb samāyānti indicates coming together or arrival.
The subject nāgakanyāḥ refers to nāga maidens.
The term sahasraśaḥ specifies arrival in thousands.
inference: Thousands of nāga maidens come together as a consequence of the practice.
plain_english: Nāga maidens come together by the thousands.
